tool_input.content:
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['SKUs as Bins']

for r in range(2, 7):
    loc = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    parts = [p.strip() for p in loc.split(',')]
    count = 0
    for p in parts:
        idx = p.find(':')
        if idx == -1:
            continue
        locstr = p[:idx]
        if locstr.startswith('X') or locstr.startswith('Z'):
            continue
        count += 1
    ws.cell(r, 3).value = count

# borders for C2:C6
for r in range(2, 7):
    c = ws.cell(r, 3)
    c.border = openpyxl.styles.Border(
        left=openpyxl.styles.Side(style='thin'),
        right=openpyxl.styles.Side(style='thin'),
        top=openpyxl.styles.Side(style='thin'),
        bottom=openpyxl.styles.Side(style='thin'),
    )
    c.font = Font(name='Courier New', size=9)

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
